flora: Floating Crinoid rafts attached to driftwood
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; soft, stylized rounded toy-like forms; clear historical mismatch storytelling.

visual_logic.composition: An expressive, comedic underwater scene emphasizing chronological confusion. ON THE LEFT SIDE: The paleontologist character 'dino_bones_paleontologist_1' is swimming forward, her long blonde hair floating in water currents beneath a customized clear-dome diving helmet. She is wearing a pink diving vest over her uniform and enthusiastically holds out a large, leafy bunch of Late Cretaceous Thalassotaenia seagrass. ON THE RIGHT SIDE: Three massive Jurassic marine reptiles float close together, looking completely bewildered. Their big, expressive animated eyes are wide with confusion, and they share a signature friendly smirk as they gesture with puzzled flippers toward the floating crinoid rafts above them, clearly indicating that the modern seaweed she brought belongs to a completely different Mesozoic Age period.
visual_logic.ground: Flat, dark blue-grey clay-rich shale base lost in deep, soft-edged shadows.
visual_logic.background: Deep indigo and charcoal-tinted pelagic water column filled with distant swirling silver bubble trails.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft underwater studio lighting with heavy ambient occlusion, creating clear contact depth and accentuating the rounded, tactile feel of the characters.
